title: 946. Delete Columns to Make Sorted III

examples.explanation: Keeping only 2 of the 5 columns (for instance the middle ones) is the most that stays ordered, so 3 columns must go.
One strictly falling row keeps at most a single column, forcing 4 deletions.
Each column already reads top-to-bottom in order, so nothing needs deleting.

hints: Maximizing kept columns is equivalent to minimizing deletions.
Column i can follow column j when no row decreases from j to i; this yields a longest-chain DP.
Compare all earlier columns j < i for every position i.
